comment: Every bitmap font of the mod: build_fonts.py turns each entry into OpenZone_Research/gui/fonts/<name>.fnt + .edds. cell = the cell height in pixels (the atlas resolution, not the size on screen: a layout sets that with "exact text size"). See README.md.

outputs.name: ozl_hand48
outputs.for: bandit, neutral: exact text size up to 32

outputs.for: bandit, neutral: exact text size 33 and up (headings)

outputs.for: duty headings up to exact text size 24
